fusions.name: Smell of Blood
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 24 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises +8% per affliction the target carries (max +40%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Breaching Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 7 tiles, then deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of where you land.

fusions.name: Feeding Run
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 12 seconds. For 5 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Trailing Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies at low health, your damage rises by 15%.
